findings.finding: H1 non-inferiority lacks estimator, one-sided confidence interval and paired sampling rule; point difference alone cannot establish margin5pp.
findings.proposed_appendix: Freeze paired unit per question, claim segmentation, adjudication blind to arm, missing/overflow handling, interval procedure and alpha before new model outcomes.

findings.finding: Truncated A estimates a different comparison from full A. Separate feasibility from fidelity; compare equal admissible budgets with recorded truncation rule, and full A only where admissible.
findings.proposed_appendix: Report A_full=NOT_EXECUTABLE separately; freeze A_budget selection without target-answer leakage. No silent truncation.

findings.finding: Fidelity fraction and signed score1/0/-1 are different estimands; density can reward terse incomplete answers.
findings.proposed_appendix: Report support fraction, contradiction fraction, target coverage, abstentions and paired score separately. Density denominator includes all delivered system/context/question bytes or provider tokens, labeled.

findings.finding: 42 named-route questions do not establish thematic recall; 6/6 controls is descriptive with uncertainty.
findings.proposed_appendix: Preserve original corpus; append separate thematic corpus and confidence bounds. Citation must match actual source/pin/claim, not regex presence.

findings.finding: Recency and centrality do not establish truth.
findings.proposed_appendix: Mandatory orders/errata and contradictions first; relevance tier, exact anchor, topical diversification, then stable timestamp/id tie-break. Whole-node selection under measured tokenizer budget; oversized mandatory set refuses.

findings.finding: Confidence header must not imply hash proves truth or removes honest uncertainty.
findings.proposed_appendix: Pins prove byte integrity/provenance only; cite source lines and status; separate verified here, declared at source, derived, open. No absence assertion from top-N alone.

findings.finding: VOZ and benchmark adoption require their existing gates.
findings.proposed_appendix: Voice remains consultative; no dispatch/gate/promotion/activation from model output. Replace automatic confirmation terminology with measured engineering pass within scope.
